patterns.note: A persistent three-column layout with fixed left and right sidebars flanking a central, vertically scrolling content area.
Extensive use of a dark mode palette with black backgrounds, white text, and a vibrant array of blue and purple accent colors for interactive elements, links, and status indicators.

The top header and both left and right sidebars remain sticky at the top of the viewport, providing constant access to search, wallet connection, and navigation, while the main content scrolls underneath.
Prominent, full-width hero-like banners with dynamic visuals (video/animation) introduce featured content, scrolling out of view to reveal subsequent content sections.
Content is primarily presented in card-based modules, organized into responsive grids or horizontal scrollable lists for displaying collections and tokens.

technique_notes: The page employs a fixed-position layout for the top navigation and sidebars, ensuring they remain visible while the central content area scrolls independently. This creates a persistent frame for interaction.

Interactive and informational elements are highlighted using a diverse palette of bright, saturated blues and purples, providing strong contrast against the dark background for clear visual hierarchy.

Hero sections leverage embedded video or CSS keyframe animations to create engaging, full-width banners that introduce featured content. These banners are designed to scroll out of view, making way for the next content block without complex parallax effects on the background itself.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced scale with clear hierarchy; headings are bold and moderately larger than body text, while small uppercase labels provide metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on cards, buttons, and input fields, contributing to a modern and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density; sections are well-separated with comfortable vertical padding, and card elements have consistent internal spacing.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its immersive, dynamic dark mode experience, achieved through a persistent three-column layout that frames a central, continuously updated content feed. The use of full-width, animated hero banners that seamlessly transition as the user scrolls creates a highly engaging and 'live' marketplace feel, moving beyond a static content presentation.
